params.val: a move that hits 2-5 times (or a Triple Kick/Triple Axel-style move) always hits its maximum number of times

verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (skilllink): for combo moves like Triple Kick/Triple Axel that also have per-hit independent accuracy checks (multiaccuracy), Skill Link removes that flag entirely -- so every hit of those moves also always connects, not just the hit COUNT being maxed.
